correctness.rationale: The explicit harmonic basis satisfies the Laplacian recurrence and has (ell+1)^2 distinct angular weights. The difference-set square parametrization is exact; the even construction gives consecutive integer frequencies, and the odd construction is injective modulo (ell+1)^2+1 with a complete lattice collision proof. The involution of nonzero odd-degree weights proves the one-site lower bound. At s=e^{-1} all rational radial polynomials are nonzero. The standalone checker passed 199 bounded exact arithmetic cases and eight full finite-field evaluation ranks, with the analytic argument carrying infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp one-closed-trajectory acquisition theorem for the complete exact-degree S3 harmonic eigenspace. It meets the algebraic dimension lower bound for even degrees, proves an unavoidable one-sample excess for odd degrees, and supplies explicit inversion and a codimension-one zero-mean range description. The result directly compares with but is not a mere restatement of rectangular Hopf sampling, and it does not claim uniform numerical conditioning.
